notes: Kohl's Home (kohls.com) - Bestsellers investigation. ACCESS: site is behind Akamai Bot Manager with a behavioral JS challenge on catalog pages; robots.txt (live-fetched, no Claude-specific disallow) checked first. Tier1 curl_cffi (safari260_ios profile) reliably fetched robots.txt and all sitemap_*.xml files (unprotected) but only returned Akamai's behavioral-challenge interstitial HTML for catalog/PLP pages. Tier2 plain Playwright chromium was hard-blocked (403 Access Denied) on the first request - fingerprint rejected outright. Tier3 Claude-in-Chrome (real connected Chrome via extension) got past the behavioral challenge after an ~6-8s wait per fresh navigation, after which real page content rendered reliably; used for all page loads below and in cl196/na196. NAVIGATION DISCOVERY FOR BESTSELLERS: (1) grepped all 6 sitemap_catalog_N.xml + sitemap_trend.xml (fetched via tier1, ~38k+ URLs) for best-sell|bestsell|top-rated|top-seller|most-popular|trending - found zero Home-relevant hits; the only 'TopRated:' facet hits were TopRated:5 (a 5-star customer-rating filter for Mens/Womens Shoes, unrelated to a bestseller merchandising concept). (2) Checked the Assortment: facet vocabulary extracted from the same sitemaps (Closeout Deals, New Arrivals, Black Friday/Cyber Monday campaigns, various named micro-collections) - no Bestsellers/Best Sellers/Top Sellers/Popular Products assortment exists. (3) Loaded the Home department landing page (catalog/for-the-home.jsp?CN=Activity:For the Home) live via Claude-in-Chrome and used find() to confirm no 'Best Sellers' nav link or category tile exists on it. (4) On every Home-scoped PLP opened for the Clearance/New-Arrivals tasks (Clearance Home Decor, Clearance Furniture, Clearance Kitchen & Dining), a 'Best Sellers' module DID appear, but it is a generic cross-page recommendation carousel (e.g. 'Sonoma Goods For Life Cinnamon Spice Cookie Candle' recurs verbatim across multiple unrelated pages' 'Best Sellers' rails) with no dedicated URL, no product count, and no independent facet/breadcrumb - this is exactly the brief's excluded case (badge/widget signal on a page, not the page itself being a Bestsellers listing) and was not recorded as a row. (5) Did not use kohls.com's own site search - /search.jsp and /search/ are explicitly Disallow'd in the live robots.txt. CONCLUSION: after real navigation/sitemap/nav investigation, Kohl's exposes no genuine standalone Bestsellers-type PLP for its Home departments (or site-wide). This is a correct absence finding, not a failure.
